summary:
Plan of w144 (guarantees, spec-integration#r40, no scenario) in .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md.
The agent's 'The ledger' section moves from the scratch ledger to `work note <initiative>` into .shop/work/<initiative>/ledger.md.
supervise_worker.py lets each round kind run `work note` only, not the rest of `work` (r40, 0066, 0068).
The initiative's name comes from the brief's Capability-proposal path; the skills' dispatches name it.
The ledger note is a separate commit after the round's own, so apply still commits spec/ alone (r6). The note is one line.
The two skills are added to the researcher's file set; delivery.toml does not exist.
No existing test breaks (notes §4).
Open cases: no initiative in the input, work note refusing the line, a BLOCKED round's line, D1 (empty note).
